title: Hoshino Ichika — Before A Troubled Pair〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Courtyard

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Let's eat♪

rows.Speaker: Honami, Ichika & Shiho
rows.Line: Let's eat.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I need to ask how they're doing. But very carefully...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Still, I'm glad we did this.
Hanasato and the others helped us realize something important.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We need to learn more about the people we're giving our gifts to. It's simple, but really important.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We might need to subtly ask during our regular conversations what they'd really enjoy receiving or if anything has been on their minds lately...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I want to get them gifts that they'll really enjoy, so I need to do my best here.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, Saki, you brought a lunch today?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. We had these really yummy croquettes for dinner last night, so I decided to bring some that were left over♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, what's in them?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Not so fast, Shiho! I saw you looking right at them! We can trade other parts of our lunches, but you're not getting any of these!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: That wasn't my plan...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Be patient. Look for the right time to ask...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Actually, now might be my chance.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(But how do I phrase my question...?
I'm trying to keep their gifts a surprise—)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Aren't you gonna eat, Ichika?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You opened the packet for your yakisoba bun, but you haven't taken a bite.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, um... I was wondering where to start.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Where to start...?
From either end, right?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Shiho, you just don't get it.
Don't you ever feel the urge to go from the middle?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I feel like that also applies to taiyaki.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I-It does.
Haha...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Is something on your mind, Ichika?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What?! How did you know...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I had an inkling...
I mean, you're the one who said we should all have lunch together...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, then...!
Does this mean you wanna ask us something?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Um...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I do, but...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
So, it's about Classical Japanese...
I remembered that I'm probably going to get called on today!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, that's right...
The girls in the column next to yours got called on last time.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Exactly! Which is why I'm pretty sure it's my column's turn today.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Classical Japanese... Giving the meaning of individual words isn't too hard, but being asked to read full passages is a different story...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Really? I actually really like reading those passages!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Especially stuff from “The Tale of Genji” or “Tsurezuregusa”.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (That was close...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (And after telling Kanade that we need to be discreet... I was being the opposite of that.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (But I should still have plenty of opportunities to ask.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (So, I should think a little more later about how to be more subtle.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (No, wait... They just asked me if something was on my mind. That sort of opened the door for me...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (If only I'd asked them then...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thanks for listening to my problem, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
So, in return, let me help you!
I'll ask the same question back!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Has anything been on your minds lately?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(Yeah...
That might've been the way to go...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Ichika, are you still deciding where to start?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, are you thinking about eating all of the yakisoba first?!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Then the bun would lose all purpose...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Haha! True♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(I should just eat for now...
I'd rather not raise their suspicions any further.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'll start here.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Mmm. So good.
